key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the author's indefinite citation formula and gendered representative human.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned ‘apart from God’ reading rather than silently substituting ‘by grace.’

key_decisions.after: But we see Jesus, made lower than the angels for a little while, crowned with glory and honor because he suffered death, so that apart from God he might taste death for everyone.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But we see him who for a little while was made lower than the angels, namely Jesus, crowned with glory and honor because of the suffering of death, so that by the grace of God he might taste death for everyone.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps divine purpose, filial image, pioneer title and suffering.

key_decisions.after: For it was fitting that God, for whom and through whom all things exist, in bringing many sons and daughters to glory, should perfect the pioneer of their salvation through sufferings.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For it was fitting that he, for whom and by whom all things exist, in bringing many sons to glory, should make the founder of their salvation perfect through suffering.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps human embodiment, death as means and named opponent.
